title: The beach and beach house
content: First pic: AI image of the wall/dam and the beach below. It's really creepy that AI can literally make this exact replica of my dream world just by me describing it in a few words literally. This is exactly what it looks like. Second pic: AI image of the outside of the beach house I'm at consistently in my dream world. Been here the past few nights frequently or have spent my entire dream here in these two places. Like many, many others the ocean is unruly and usually has giant enormous sneaker waves so you can never turn your back to the ocean 🌊, at least I don't because I'm always concerned I will be swept away. If I walk on the beach there are sometimes other people, sometimes none. There are caves you can walk into, and I get the feeling this is an island of some sort. If I am inside the house I am usually cleaning up after a big party, or I am like not supposed to be there and it's not my house but I am there to clean it? I don't know it's a strange dynamic. I'm not allowed to go in the back bedroom, only the front of the house which is the patio side overlooking the cliff/ocean. I'm often very busy inside the beach house by getting cleaning tasks done, organizing things. Usually I will clean the whole house spotless and then bam it goes back to its original condition like a magic house that has to stay dirty so all my work was for nothing, and I'm always expecting someone but they never come. Or they sometimes come home to check on the house and they have a judgy vibe and never talk to me they just go back into the back bedroom. It's a white woman with blonde hair and a man with dark skin maybe an Indian man. That's all for now 😆🩷
